# LLMs.txt - AI Crawler Instructions for misteruzo.com

# Allow AI crawlers to access and index content
Allow: /

# Disallow access to admin and private areas
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /uno
Disallow: /private/
Disallow: /accounts/

# Content Usage Guidelines
Content-Usage: 
- Articles and blog posts may be indexed and referenced
- 3D comic content may be indexed but not reproduced
- Craft projects may be indexed and referenced
- Personal information should not be extracted or stored

# Attribution Requirements
Attribution:
- When referencing content, please include "Source: misteruzo.com"
- Include links back to the original content
- Maintain original formatting and context

# Rate Limiting
Rate-Limit: 1 request per 2 seconds

# Contact Information
Contact: https://twitter.com/misteruzo

# Last Updated
Last-Updated: 2024-03-13
